items.exampleEn: The composer wrote this song for his wife.
items.exampleZh: 這位作曲家為他太太寫了這首歌。

items.exampleEn: This comic is about a cat and a dog.
items.exampleZh: 這本漫畫在講一隻貓和一隻狗。

items.exampleEn: My brother listens to rap every day.
items.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天都聽饒舌音樂。

items.exampleEn: This old radio has very good audio quality.
items.exampleZh: 這台舊收音機的音質很好。

items.exampleEn: We heard singing from the next room.
items.exampleZh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來歌聲。

items.exampleEn: There is an amusement park near our town.
items.exampleZh: 我們鎮附近有一座遊樂園。

items.exampleEn: The clown had a red nose and big shoes.
items.exampleZh: 那個小丑有紅鼻子和一雙大鞋子。

items.sentenceEn: We went to the amusement park on Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 我們星期天去了遊樂園。

items.audioEn: At the party, there was a clown, a magic show and lots of singing.
items.audioZh: 派對上有一個小丑、一場魔術表演，還有很多人在唱歌。

items.sentenceEn: I love reading comics on the weekend.
My little sister loves singing and dancing.

items.stemZh: 貝多芬是一位偉大的作曲家。

items.stemEn: The clown told a ____ story, and everyone laughed.
items.stemZh: 小丑講了一個滑稽的故事，大家都笑了。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday was Amy's son's birthday, so she took him to an amusement park. There was a funny clown who told comic stories. Then a young man did a short rap, and all the children joined in the singing. "This is my best birthday ever!" her son said.
items.passageZh: 上週六是 Amy 兒子的生日，所以她帶他去遊樂園。那裡有一個很好笑的小丑在講滑稽的故事。接著一位年輕人表演了一段饒舌，所有孩子都跟著一起唱。她兒子說：「這是我過過最棒的生日！」

items.promptZh: 我喜歡在睡前聽有聲故事。
referenceEn: I like to listen to audio stories before bed.
I like listening to audio stories before I go to bed.
rubricZh: 「有聲故事」可寫 audio stories（audio 放在名詞前）
「睡前」可寫例如 before bed、before I go to bed

items.instructionZh: 用 singing 造一個句子，說說你或家人唱歌的情形。
referenceEn: My mother's singing is better than mine.
I enjoy singing in the shower.
rubricZh: singing 當名詞表示「唱歌；歌聲」（例如 her singing、enjoy singing）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My mother's singing is）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："made a comic face" 不道地，慣用說法是 made a funny face；comic 作形容詞多用於 comic story／comic actor；建議換題幹（例如 "He told a ____ story, and everyone laughed."）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "The clown told a ____ story, and everyone laughed."（原 "The clown made a ____ face, and everyone laughed."）；made a comic face 不道地，改 comic story；選項與正解不變
